passage:
On a sunny morning, Ryan's mother told him to take an umbrella because rain was expected. Ryan looked at the clear sky and left without it.
After school, heavy rain began. Ryan waited at the gate, hoping it would stop.
A classmate shared her umbrella with him. They walked slowly to the bus stop, both getting a little wet.
At home, Ryan's mother did not say, "I told you so." She simply handed him a dry towel.
The next day, Ryan checked the weather report himself.
He learned that clear skies do not always tell the whole story. Listening to advice may feel unnecessary in the morning but useful in the afternoon.

questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “Ryan looked at the clear sky and left without it.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The Slow Walker」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Umbrella Basket」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Late Train」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The Forgotten Umbrella: Ryan looked at the clear sky and left without it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
